title: A KPI tile's trend line runs edge to edge across the card and joins across days with no value
custom_preconds:
Dashboard v1, a KPI hero tile (e.g. Billing Efficiency) on a range whose first days and some middle days have no value (nothing clocked).
Owning test: app/src/components/ts/dashboard/layout/tests/DashboardHeroTile.spec.ts, describe 'sparkline spans the full card (SV-11328)'.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open the Dashboard and set the tile to This Month.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The trend line starts at the left edge of the card (the range's start).

custom_steps_separated.content: Look at where the line rises and falls.
custom_steps_separated.expected: Each rise or fall sits at the date it happened in the range; days with no value are bridged by the line, not drawn as gaps or lone dots.

custom_steps_separated.content: Look at the right end of the line.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The line reaches the right edge (the range's end); the dot sits on the latest day that has a value.
